releasebot: Autobump proposal: repo=redwood/api branch=main change_scope=infra-only (k8s scaling tweak). Proposed version bump: 2.12.3 -> 2.12.4 (patch). Window 02:00 UTC. Should we auto-patch or mark as buildmeta-only and skip semver bump? @sofia @raj
sofia: If it's purely k8s annotation and doesn't change API surface, I'm leaning to skipping the patch. But we still need a changelog note.
raj: We usually only skip for docs-only or telemetry defaults. Infra changes that affect runtime env can affect behavior. What's actually changed in the diff?
releasebot: Diff snippet:
```diff
- replicaCount: 3
+ replicaCount: 4
- image.tag: v2.12.3
+ image.tag: v2.12.3
```
Only a scaling hint, no config keys or image updates.
olivia: Scaling bump is operational, not an API change. Vote: skip semver bump, attach buildmeta `2.12.3+infra.20260314`, and add a changelog line 'adjust replica target for k8s autoscaling test'. :thumbsup:
alice: One caution: our deploybot auto-rollout uses semver tags to decide canary audiences. If we don't bump the version, metrics for the new rollout will be attached to the same version and could muddy perf/regressions.
mike: We can avoid that by emitting deploy metadata separate from the semver tag. Deploybot already supports `release_metadata` on events (example: `release_metadata:{"deploy_event":"infra-scaling-2026-03-14"}`).
raj: If deploybot will attach metadata and we include a changelog entry, I'm fine skipping the patch. Proposal: skip only when NO build artifacts changed, NO API surface change, AND files changed are subset of infra/ops or docs.
sofia: Agreed. Proposed policy (short): `skip_semver_bump_when = (files ⊆ {infra/, ops/, docs/}) && (no build output change) && (must add changelog entry)`. Also require a release note line and `buildmeta` tag on the deploy event.
releasebot: I'll update the autobump heuristic accordingly. New heuristic: `skip_if = (changed_paths in infra_paths && !build_artifact_changed)`. Will annotate the run with buildmeta `infra-scaling-20260314`. Also opening PR to releasebot config + changelog checklist.
olivia: :+1: Can we also expose a checkbox in the release UI to force a bump in edge cases (PM/legal audit wants a formal version)?
deploybot: Action queued: releasebot will annotate this run with buildmeta `infra-scaling-20260314` and WILL NOT create a new semver tag unless `force_bump=true`. (run_id: 2026-03-14_02_10)
